blocks.heading: What is CP10?
blocks.body: GH-axis blend profile pairing CJC-1295 without DAC and Ipamorelin. The source highlights GH and IGF-1 marker increases from CJC-1295 and selective GH release without ACTH or cortisol increase from Ipamorelin.
